chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Al-Hasan ibn Atiyya, from Uzafir Al-Sayrafi, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Do you see these disfigured in creation?' I said, 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'They are those whose fathers had intercourse with their wives during menstruation.'
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of disfigurement in creation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the 'Mushabbihun' (those who liken God to creation, often associated with the Ghulat or extreme anthropomorphists) as having a distinct physical or spiritual disfigurement. He links this condition to their fathers engaging in sexual intercourse with their mothers during menstruation, suggesting a causal or indicative relationship between this specific act of disobedience and the physical manifestation of their theological deviation.
